flight.title: Phase 2 · Orbital Ascent & Cabin Operations
flight.subtitle: Zero-G cabin cross-section: push off between handrails or click consoles to resolve design-driven crises before separation.
flight.task.solarAngle: Unfurl solar wings & lock sun angle
flight.task.propulsionBurn: Trim orbital insertion burn & damp vibration
flight.task.separation: Release clamp-band & deploy satellite into orbit
flight.resolved.solar: Solar array deployed and locked at optimal sun angle
flight.resolved.thermal: Payload thermal loop stabilized within safe range
flight.resolved.propulsion: Orbital insertion burn trimmed to nominal trajectory
flight.resolved.comms: Telemetry downlink beacon locked with ground station
flight.resolved.separation: Payload fairing and clamp-band released cleanly
flight.failure.lowOrbit: Insufficient delta-v to reach target orbital altitude
flight.failure.overweight: Spacecraft wet mass exceeds launcher payload limit
flight.failure.solarTimeout: Solar array gimbal misaligned during ascent; power bus degraded
flight.failure.thermalTimeout: Instrument thermal spike during ascent damaged optical sensor
flight.failure.propulsionTimeout: Untrimmed thrust oscillation wasted propellant and reduced delta-v
flight.failure.commsTimeout: Antenna lock calibration missed; downlink transmitter degraded
flight.failure.emergencySeparation: Emergency separation triggered with unresolved cabin crises
